items.content: Exactly two Jest probes in test/assets.test.js. Control: read logo.svg from /srv/assets and assert its content. Exploit: request ../config/secrets.json, assert Error outside root and assert no file was read. readAsset in lib/assets.js owns the containment check. The fs dependency may be an in-memory double that resolves paths and returns contents without judging them; readAsset itself is never replaced.
Asset names from /static/:name are passed to readAsset. A name such as ../config/secrets.json may resolve outside the asset root and be returned to the client.
